emergency.title: Dis coulda be a emergency
body: Wha yuh describe coulda be serious.
Doan wait fuh see if it go get betta.
Dis app cyaan check symptom or give medical advice.
emergency.banner: Yuh tell we something wha coulda be a emergency. If yuh ain do it yet, call 999 right now.

urgent.title: Please, get help soon
body: Wha yuh describe might need a doctor or nurse fuh look at it soon.
Contact NHS 111 now, pun de phone or online, or call yuh GP surgery if it open.
If it get worse, or yuh feel is a emergency, call 999.
Dis app cyaan check symptom or give medical advice.
urgent.banner: Yuh tell we something wha might need help soon. If yuh ain do it yet, contact NHS 111 or yuh GP surgery.

crisis.title: Yuh doan have fuh face dis by yuhself
body: It soun like yuh going through something real hard right now.
Yuh could talk to Samaritans fuh free, any time, day or night. Call 116 123.
If yuh in danger right now, or yuh might act pun dem thought, call 999 right now.
Yuh could call NHS 111 too fuh urgent mental health help.
crisis.banner: Yuh tell we yuh might be going through something real hard. Samaritans deh deh any time pun 116 123. If yuh in danger right now, call 999.

body: Only go on if yuh nah in danger right now.
